mapper.select: SELECT t.template_id, t.template_type, t.name, t.description, ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM template_shop i JOIN template_shop_group g ON g.template_shop_group_id = i.template_shop_group_id WHERE g.template_id = t.template_id) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM template_figure_type i JOIN template_figure_type_group g ON g.template_figure_type_group_id = i.template_figure_type_group_id WHERE g.template_id = t.template_id) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM template_series i JOIN template_series_group g ON g.template_series_group_id = i.template_series_group_id WHERE g.template_id = t.template_id) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM template_genre_character i JOIN template_genre_character_group g ON g.template_genre_character_group_id = i.template_genre_character_group_id WHERE g.template_id = t.template_id) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM template_maker i WHERE i.template_id = t.template_id) ) AS item_count, CONCAT('/uploads/', th.file_path) AS thumbnail_url FROM template t LEFT JOIN thumbnail_image th ON th.target_type = 'TEMPLATE' AND th.target_id = t.template_id WHERE #{templateType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR t.template_type = #{templateType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY t.template_type, t.name

SELECT t.template_id, t.template_type, t.name, t.description, ( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM template_shop i JOIN template_shop_group g ON g.template_shop_group_id = i.template_shop_group_id WHERE g.template_id = t.template_id) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM template_figure_type i JOIN template_figure_type_group g ON g.template_figure_type_group_id = i.template_figure_type_group_id WHERE g.template_id = t.template_id) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM template_series i JOIN template_series_group g ON g.template_series_group_id = i.template_series_group_id WHERE g.template_id = t.template_id) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM template_genre_character i JOIN template_genre_character_group g ON g.template_genre_character_group_id = i.template_genre_character_group_id WHERE g.template_id = t.template_id) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM template_maker i WHERE i.template_id = t.template_id) ) AS item_count, CONCAT('/uploads/', th.file_path) AS thumbnail_url FROM template t LEFT JOIN thumbnail_image th ON th.target_type = 'TEMPLATE' AND th.target_id = t.template_id WHERE t.template_id = #{templateId}
